name: pa-restoration
description: £10k net personal pension pulls ANI from £110k to £97.5k, crossing the £100k taper boundary and fully restoring the Personal Allowance (7570 → 12570). This is the bug a naive computeBands reuse (taper off gross) misses. Income-tax expected values RE-DERIVED to HMRC method under D-015 §8.3/G4: before £110k − PA 7,570 → £33,432; after grossed £12,500 → ANI £97,500 (PA restored), taxable £97,430, ext. basic band £50,200 → £50,200 @ 20% (£10,040) + £47,230 @ 40% (£18,892) = £28,932; taxSaved £4,500 unchanged (both legs shift +£2,514, so the relief delta is invariant).
